title: Searched baseline vector vs the hand-written control, NLHE, validation partition
description: Stage 1 promotion check for the parameter search (strategy.search). Arm A is the baseline policy at its hand-written defaults, arm B the search's final incumbent; both are packaged bundles built by strategy.search.validate. Official format: 8 seats, 2,000 chips, 200-hand cap. Promotion needs the paired 95% interval's lower bound above min_effect (1.0 point per tournament, declared before the run).
